description: This PHP class 'ComposerValidator' is part of Drupal's package_manager module. It implements event subscription to validate Composer configuration and environment, ensuring correct Composer version and HTTPS settings, and providing help links.

classes.name: ComposerValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing event subscription to validate Composer environment and settings within Drupal's package_manager module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: ComposerInspector, PathLocator, and ModuleHandlerInterface.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates Composer executable version and HTTPS settings, adding errors to the event if requirements are not met.

methods.name: getHelpUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL to a specific help page fragment within the Package Manager documentation.
